description: Test suite for config issue formatting functions, including normalization and line formatting, using Vitest.

methods.name: normalizeConfigIssue
methods.description: Normalizes configuration issue metadata for machine output, removing hidden allowedValues if count exceeds threshold.

methods.name: normalizeConfigIssuePath
methods.description: Converts empty or null paths to <root>.

methods.name: normalizeConfigIssues
methods.description: Normalizes a list of configuration issues.

methods.name: formatConfigIssueLine
methods.description: Formats a single configuration issue line with optional normalization.

methods.name: formatConfigIssueLines
methods.description: Formats multiple configuration issues into lines, with normalization.
